simple.meaning: נָא (nâʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “'I pray' , 'now' , or 'then' ; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 403 times in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 12:11. The surrounding contexts include family, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָא (H4994) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.short: 'I pray' , 'now' , or 'then' ; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
definitions.usage: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.
definitions.full: H4994. na I. נָא particle of entreaty or exhortation I (we) pray, now (enclitic) (Syriac , ; compare Ethiopic veni, age! Di § 160. 1 Lex:675 Kö ii. 244 ); — attached: 1 to the imperative, especially in colloquial style , when it expresses an entreaty or admonition, as Gen 12:13 אִמְרִינָֿא say, I pray , 13:9 הִמָּרֶדֿ מֵעָלַי נָא , 13:14 עֵינֶיךָ שָׂאנָֿא , 15:5 השׁמימה הַבֶּטנָֿא , 24:2 + often, Num 20:10 המוֺרים שׁמעונֿא , Judg 13:4 ; 16:6 , 10 , 28 ; 18:5 , etc., Isa 1:18 ; 5:3 ; Amos 7:2 , 5 ; rarely in a command, Gen 22:2 ; Isa 7:3 ). Ironically, in a challenge, 47:12 ; Job 40:10 . Once anomalously attached to a substantive, or (accents) prefixed to a verb, Num 12:13 נָא֖ רְָפא נָא֛ אֵ֕ל (Ew § 246 a Di אַלנָֿא ; see 3b ). 2 to the perfect with waw consecutive, in a precative sense (Dr § 119 δ ) Gen 40:14 . 3 to the imperfect, when leave is asked , or a prayer or desire expressed; a. in 1 person, especially with ה cohortative, Gen 19:8 אוציאהנֿא let me, I pray , bring out, 19:20 שָׁ֑מָּה אִמָּֽלְטָהנָּֿא , 24:12 לְפָנַי הַקְרֵהנָֿא 24:14 הַטִּינָֿא 24:17 ; 24:23 ; 24:43 ; 24:45 ; 25:30 ; 32:12 , 30 + often, Exod 3:18 נלכהנֿא let us go, I pray , Num 20:17 ; Isa 5:5 ; and in self-deliberation, Gen 18:21 ארדהנּֿא I will go down, now ! Exod 3:3 ואראה אסורהנּֿא I will turn aside, now , and see, 2Sam 14:15 ; Song 3:2 ; Isa 5:1 ; with אַל Job 32:21 . b. in 2 person, with אַל , in deprecation, Gen 18:3 עבדך מעל תעבר אלנֿא , 19:7 ; 47:29 ; Num 10:31 , etc.; hence elliptical אלנֿא do not, I pray , (do this,) Gen 19:18 ; 33:10 ; Num 12:13 Ew Di. c. in 3 person , Gen 18:4 יֻקַּחנָֿא let there be brought, I pray , 26:28 ; 33:14 ; 44:18 , 33 , etc., 2Sam 14:11-12 , 17 ; 1Kin 17:21 ; 2Kin 2:9 ; Psa 7:10 ; 118:2 ; 118:3 ; ironically Isa 19:12 ; 47:13 , or defiantly Jer 17:15 where is the word of J.? נָא יָבוֺא ; with אַל , Gen 13:8 מְרִיבָה תְהִי אַלנָֿא , 18:30 לַאדֹנָי יִחַר אַלנָֿא , 37:27 ; Num 12:12 . 4 joined to conjunctions and interjections: a. [ אָהּנָֿא , contracted] אָ֫נָּא . b. אַלנָֿא see above 3b, c. c. אִםנָֿא , especially in the phrase בעיניך חן מצאתי נא אם , used by one craving a favourable hearing Gen 30:27 ; 33:10 ; Judg 6:17 ; 1Sam 27:5 , and with נא repeated in the request itself Gen 18:3 ; 47:29 ; 50:4 ; Exod 33:13 ; 34:9 ; otherwise Gen 24:42 . d. הִנֵּהנָֿא behold, I pray , craving a favourable consideration of the fact pointed to by הִנֵּה , and of the request founded upon it (with which נא is often repeated), Gen 12:11 ; 16:2 ; 18:27 , 31 ; 19:2 , 8 , 19 , 20 ; 27:2 ; Judg 13:3 ; 19:9 ; 1Sam 9:6 ; 16:15 ; 2Sam 13:24 ; 2Kin 2:16 , 19 ; 4:9 +, Job 13:18 ; 33:2 ; 40:15-16 ,. e. ( לנו ) לי אוֺינָֿא Woe, now , to me (us) ! Jer 4:31 ; 45:3 ; Lam 5:16 . f. אַיֵּהנָֿא where, pray ? Psa 115:2 . g. נֶגְדָּהנָּֿא , peculiarly, Psa 116:14 ; 116:18 my vows to J. I will perform, לכלעֿמו נגדהנֿא O that (it may be) before all his people ! II. נָא adjective see ניא . II. נָא adjective raw , of flesh Exod 12:9 (P; opposed to בשׁל ). I. נָא [ נִיב ], נֵיבָ֑י נִיבָ֑י, see נוב . נִיד v . נוד . נִירָה see II. נדד . נָיוֺת see נוית below I. נוה . נִיתוֺתַ נִיחֹחַ, see נוח . נִין see נון .
